Also in USNF. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Dextrin). Maize, potato, or cassava starch partially hydrolysed and modified by heating with or without the presence of acids, alkalis, or pH control agents. A white or almost white, free-flowing powder. Very soluble in boiling water forming a mucilaginous solution; slowly soluble in cold water; practically insoluble in alcohol. A 5% dispersion in water has a pH of 2.0 to 8.0. USNF 26 (Dextrin).
